ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Ransomware Activity Using LegalNotice Message
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect changes to the "LegalNoticeCaption" or "LegalNoticeText" registry values where the message set contains keywords often used in ransomware ransom messages Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\LegalNoticeCaption.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\LegalNoticeText.*")) AND (Details = RGX(".*encrypted.*") OR Details = RGX(".*Unlock\\-Password.*") OR Details = RGX(".*paying.*")))
